dossier.scp_unleashed.001_scarlet.title: The Scarlet King
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_scarlet.captio: An emblem recovered from a burned ritual site, maker unknown
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_scarlet.page.0: SCP-001 cannot be contained by any means available to the Foundation. Containment efforts are directed instead at delaying its arrival.
Groups devoted to SCP-001 are to be located and dispersed. Personnel who encounter robed figures gathered in a circle are to break up the gathering before it concludes.
The manifestation index is to be watched by every reader of this file. Any sudden rise is to be reported at once.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_scarlet.page.1: SCP-001 is an entity named in recovered texts as the Scarlet King. It is not present in this world. It is believed to be held somewhere far below, bound by seven chains.

The pressure SCP-001 places against its bonds is tracked by the manifestation index. The index rises slowly on its own, and faster whenever its followers complete their rites. As it climbs, the chains give way one by one. None has ever been seen to mend.
Should the index reach its limit, the sky is expected to turn red within hours, and an XK-2 scenario will follow within days.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_scarlet.page.2: The following lines were found scratched into the floor of a burned ritual site.
Seven thrones beneath a red sky. Seven chains that will not hold. Seven names for one King.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_scarlet.page.3: Older accounts describe a practice that once set the King back. They speak of a door that opens onto sand, and say the old rites asked for a living offering and a walk of the circle, sunwise then widdershins.
One account claims the King can be met on its own ground once the sky has turned, if something gentle is brought there and offered in its place. The account was not taken seriously.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_scarlet.page.4: Read no further into this file than you must. Every new reader is one more voice in the King's ear.
